title: Assistant agentic async tool-runtime bridge and suspend/resume
intent: Normalize agent model tool calls into AssistantToolObservation values while preserving Bahia's event-native Nostr/ContextVM async mutation semantics.
scope: Execute read-only sync tools inline through the MCP tool-call adapter and return completed observations.
Evaluate assistant permissions before every tool execution and normalize ask/deny decisions into deferred/denied observations.
Dispatch policy-allowed async mutation tools, persist agent_loop waiting_async metadata with the AsyncToolReceipt, and return without waiting for terminal events.
Resume waiting async work from receipt metadata through the existing downstream Nostr result observer and fail closed to blocked on relay/observer closure.
Extend startup recovery to resume waiting_async agent loops from AssistantSession.Metadata.
out_of_scope: The multi-step agent loop that consumes observations.
New Nostr event kinds or payload contracts.
architecture_notes: internal/service cannot import internal/mcp without creating an import cycle, so the runtime exposes service-local descriptor/result projection interfaces for item 8 to adapt from mcp.Server and mcp.AssistantToolRegistry.

Async terminal observation reuses AssistantOrchestrator.observeDownstreamResult through the ObserveAssistantAsyncResult adapter, preserving scoped subscriptions on receipt.ResultKinds plus e=RequestEventID and existing event validation.
waiting_async state is stored in AssistantSession.Metadata.agent_loop using AssistantAgentLoopMetadata; deferred approvals are stored in Metadata.deferred_actions.
